lines.text: The point I am coming to folks, is that the barrier is a factor but it is not the ultimate factor.
And who knows maybe that 1% is the difference between your business surviving or getting washed away.
But when you have built the thing and you are running the thing, you will run into the 1% problems.
But if you want to build great products and great businesses, you can’t ignore the 1%.
And yeah that’s when you’ll need Tech, and that’s when you’ll need humans.
